entries.25056df7f6d99618: This business provides the introduction, maintenance and operation of administrative information systems and other systems for local governments, as well as the construction and maintenance of communication systems, including disaster prevention administrative radio systems. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥8,477 million, the largest of the four reportable segments. The consolidated subsidiaries Minami Osaka Electronic Computing Center Co., Ltd. and Synergy Co., Ltd. also conduct this business.
entries.2f375f30580f1c79: CYBERLINKS is an information services company headquartered in Wakayama City, Wakayama Prefecture, and consists of the company and two consolidated subsidiaries. It operates mainly by providing the shared cloud service "Share Cloud," and as of December 31, 2025, had 815 consolidated employees. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.73e55904049ef89b: Under an agency agreement with Connexio Corporation, the primary agency of NTT DOCOMO, INC., the business operates ten docomo Shop outlets in Wakayama Prefecture as a secondary agency. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥4,209 million.
entries.76a306af9bb1930d: This business provides the digital certificate issuance service "CloudCerts," which uses blockchain technology, and develops trust services using the My Number Card. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥147 million.
entries.77ca18e0246a7207: This business provides cloud-based services, mainly the core business operations cloud service "@rms Core" for food retailers, as well as services for wholesalers, including EDI services for which a major food wholesaler is the main customer, a product image database, and a multilingual sales management system. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥5,301 million.
entries.9f3957a3ff30730e: An information services company that provides shared-use cloud services to food retail and wholesale businesses and local governments, and also operates docomo Shops.
